regions.full_page: He seemed quite himself; did not exactly complain against anyone, but seemed rather to wonder, what it all should come to. He told me he did not know what to think about it. He had been to a friend of his - a lawyer - yesterday and told him all about the case, to see if he could get something decided etc. I told him as much as that I had not been personally edified at what seemed to me his want of fervor or devotion to holy Communion while he was with us in Our Lady of Angels; and therefore I thought he ought to turn earnestly to Headquarters - meaning the Tabernacle and make some promise to do better in this, or some other regard, if things adjusted themselves favorably to his peace. Then he said something about making a retreat with the Jesuites. I told him that would, in my opinion, be the best thing he could do. I told him I would write you about him and he said he wished I would. I wanted to tell Father Guardian of my visit and of my proposition to write you all about the case, but I decided it as prudent to say nothing to him about it. Before I had a chance to do so, before deciding, he forbade me to correspond with "3r. P." and at culpa before dinner gave quite a little admonition, in a general way, bearing on this case, while we all knelt as novices. Now Dear Father Provincial I do not wish to blame anyone or to excuse anyone else. "Brother Paschal" seems to me willing to be directed. He seems quite conscious that he did not receive entirely "a fair deal" with the superior above -- - Well, may our dear Lord God direct him and us all We received quite a large package of certificates yesterday, for the Seraphic Mass Association. They came in good time and shape. Fr. Guardian just told me that the cash received this month already is $1002. 00. Thanks be to God! the reports of favors as through this source continue. Fr. Adelhelm was down Today from Glencliff with chronicles and good reports. As far as I know all the brethren in this end of the Province are well. The student John Parsons in Yonkers seems quite improved.
